Usage: opencli youtube <command> [args] [options]

channel, comments, feed, history, like, login, playlist, search, subscribe, subscriptions,
transcript, unlike, unsubscribe, video, watch-later, whoami

Commands:
  channel <id> [options]      [read] Get YouTube channel info and recent videos
  comments <url> [options]    [read] Get YouTube video comments
  feed [options]              [read] Get YouTube homepage recommended videos
  history [options]           [read] Get YouTube watch history
  like <url>                  [write] Like a YouTube video
  login [options]             [write] Open youtube login and wait until the browser session is authenticated
  playlist <id> [options]     [read] Get YouTube playlist info and video list
  search <query> [options]    [read] Search YouTube videos
  subscribe <channel>         [write] Subscribe to a YouTube channel
  subscriptions [options]     [read] List subscribed YouTube channels
  transcript <url> [options]  [read] Get YouTube video transcript/subtitles
  unlike <url>                [write] Remove like from a YouTube video
  unsubscribe <channel>       [write] Unsubscribe from a YouTube channel
  video <url>                 [read] Get YouTube video metadata (title, views, description, etc.)
  watch-later [options]       [read] Get your YouTube Watch Later queue
  whoami                      [read] Show the current logged-in youtube account

Common options:
  -f, --format <fmt>  Output format: table, plain, json, yaml, md, csv  default: table  choices: table, plain, json, yaml, md, csv
  --trace <mode>      Trace capture: off, on, retain-on-failure  default: off  choices: off, on, retain-on-failure
  -v, --verbose       Debug output  default: false
  -h, --help          display help for command

Browser common options:
  --window <mode>        Browser window mode: foreground or background  choices: foreground, background
  --site-session <mode>  Adapter site session lifecycle: ephemeral or persistent  choices: ephemeral, persistent
  --keep-tab <bool>      Keep the browser tab lease after the command finishes  choices: true, false

Agent tip: use 'opencli youtube --help -f yaml' to get all command args/options in one structured response.
